description.pass_when: Both offline detectors complete without detecting a supported secret in all selected supported package text.
description.fail_when: A supported secret is detected in coherently bound package text, including a retained positive when inspection is incomplete.
description.not_applicable_when: No package source was selected. Selected unreadable, unsupported, changed or incomplete packages remain UNKNOWN unless supported positive evidence is retained.
